correctness.rationale: For beta_i=w_(m+i)/w_(m-i) the exact adjacent quotient comparison has numerator difference (2t+1)(i(i+1)-rt(t+1)), so beta_i starts below one and has at most one upward crossing; the alpha_i sequence is U-shaped. Its total sum equals E[(X-2m)_+]>0. The necessary endpoint tail P(X>=2rt)>P(X=0) is proved for all r>=3,t>=1: Vandermonde supermultiplicativity of A_(r,t)=C((2t+1)r,r)(t/(t+1))^(2tr) with exact seed values covers t=1..5 including four exceptional tail sums, and an independent geometric-sum event with a monotone positive log ratio covers t>=6. Exact-rational standalone checks replayed 105 sign vectors, 2142 quotients and 343 supermultiplicativity cases; the unbounded claim relies on these analytic steps, not finite checks.

originality.rationale: The 2020 preprint and 2022 published full texts define left-loadedness; the latter explicitly presents the reciprocal-failure-probability negative-binomial case as an expectation, while proving only right-skewness for negative binomials. The 2007 Simmons extension supports a first centered-tail comparison but does not establish an entire sign pattern as far as its available abstract and the precise 2022 citation show. The earlier established Poisson L1 case concerns different distributions; prior full-vector binomial results concern finite-support laws; no inspected stronger theorem logically covers every integer-shape negative binomial L1 vector. value.rationale: The centered left-minus-right tail vector is the full hypothesis in a published convolution inequality, and its negative-binomial validity was explicitly identified as plausible but not proved for reciprocal failure probabilities. Proving the entire sign pattern for every integer shape r>=3 is structurally stronger than a center-tail Simmons inequality, fills a natural family-level gap, and permits negative-binomial increments in the published transfer result. The finite endpoint exceptions and the Vandermonde propagation show that this is not just a parameter substitution or trivial exercise; arbitrary parameter extensions remain open.
